import type { TabBarContract } from '@unofficial-krds/contracts';
import { KrdsElement } from '../base.js';
export declare class TabBar extends KrdsElement {
    static properties: {
        items: {
            attribute: boolean;
        };
        currentId: {
            type: StringConstructor;
            attribute: string;
        };
        menuAction: {
            attribute: boolean;
        };
    };
    items: TabBarContract['items'];
    currentId: string;
    menuAction: TabBarContract['menuAction'];
    constructor();
    render(): import("lit").TemplateResult<1>;
}
